claims.evidence: One source per independent SILAC culture per channel. "293-F10" is the paper's name for the FLP-In T-REx 293 c.o.-3xFLAG-F10 line. BR1/BR2/BR3 are the MaxQuant experiment names in experimentalDesignTemplate.txt (BR1 = SILAC1 files 2013-10-02, BR2 = SILAC2 files 2013-10-02, BR3 = SILAC files 2013-12-03). Paper: "Three biological replicates were obtained from separately passaged cultures and doxycycline inductions."

claims.location: comment[label] rows 1-3,7-9,13-15 and rows 4-6,10-12,16-18; characteristics[treatment]/factor value[treatment]
claims.value: SILAC light = uninduced (untreated); SILAC heavy = doxycycline-induced
claims.evidence: Explicit: paper (A) and PRIDE protocol "Cells grown in the presence of heavy media were then induced with 50 ng/ml doxycycline for 10 h. Cells were harvested and mixed 1:1 (heavy/light)"; Experimental Design: "H-labeled cells were treated with doxycycline ... mixed with uninduced, L-labeled cells". MaxQuant Labels1 = Arg10;Lys8 (heavy). Data check: DIAPH1 (mDia1) pS22, which the paper reports as increased on F10 induction, has normalized H/L 14.7 / 16.5 / 12.8 in BR1/BR2/BR3 -> heavy = induced in all 3 replicates, 0 discrepancies.
MaxQuant multiplicity 2: Labels0 empty (light), Labels1 Arg10;Lys8 (heavy). Labels written bare as in the batch-1 examples.
Heavy cells induced with 50 ng/ml doxycycline for 10 h to express F10 (tet-inducible pcDNA5/FRT/TO-c.o.-3xFLAG-F10). NCIT:C457 Doxycycline verified live; written lower case as a bare value.
Light cells were uninduced (no doxycycline). Batch rule 4: controls = untreated (template-prescribed). Validator warning: untreated is not an NCIT/EFO label.

claims.value: 1,2,3 within each treatment group (BR1->1, BR2->2, BR3->3)
claims.evidence: Three independent cultures/inductions per condition; numbering restarts per factor value group (README.adoc:330). Each culture in a condition has its own number.
"Each sample was analyzed in triplicate by LC-MS/MS"; file suffixes _01.._03 per mixed sample; MaxQuant puts all three files of a BR in one experiment with no fraction numbers.
No fractionation: experimentalDesignTemplate.txt Fraction column empty; the three files per BR are replicate injections, not fractions.

claims.location: comment[data file] and assay name rows 1-18
claims.evidence: PRIDE deposits each raw file inside a single-member .zip (OT2_Traktman_*_TiO2_0n.zip); the central directory of each zip lists exactly one <stem>.raw, which is the vendor RAW named here (rule: vendor RAW only). Names match the mqpar filePaths.
Cellosaurus CVCL_U427 OX NCBI_TaxID=9606; PRIDE organism Homo sapiens.

Paper Cell Lines: "Flp-In T-REx 293 cells (Invitrogen) ... cotransfected with pOG44 and ... pcDNA5/FRT/TO-c.o.-3xFLAG-F10"; SILAC used "FLP-In T-REx 293 c.o.-3xFLAG-F10 cells". Cellosaurus CVCL_U427 cross-references "DR EFO; EFO_0022682" and "DR BTO; BTO_0006149"; OLS EFO:0022682 label "Flp-In-T-REx" (T-REx cell derivative with targeted integration of a Flp-In expression vector), verified live, not obsolete. The derived 293-F10 line has no Cellosaurus or ontology record of its own, so the parental line term is used.

Cellosaurus AG "Fetus"; UBERON:0007220 (in EFO) label "late embryonic stage", exact synonyms "fetal stage", "fetus stage", "fetus". Batch rule 9: developmental stage from Cellosaurus age.
TiO2-based phosphopeptide enrichment (paper (B), PRIDE protocol). EFO:0010806 is a descendant of EFO:0009090; definition cites TiO2.
All 9 raw headers read "LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS" (not Velos Pro); paper and PRIDE agree.
Raw scan events "Activation Type: CID"; MaxQuant spectra files allSpectra.CID.ITMS.*.
All 9 raw headers: "Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0".
Raw scan events 2..: "ITMS + c norm Dep MS/MS"; the LTQ is a linear ion trap. Method name Phospho-MSA98-196_Top10_240min.
Raw scan event 1: "FTMS + p norm res=60000 o(375.0-2000.0)" in all 9 files.
Raw scan events "Dep MS/MS Most intense ion from (1)" (Top10 DDA).

Paper (B)/PRIDE protocol: "digested with trypsin gold, MS grade (Promega)". The MaxQuant search rule was Trypsin/P, max 2 missed cleavages (mqpar <protease>Trypsin/P</protease>); per batch rule 2 the digestion enzyme is annotated and the search rule is recorded here only.
mqpar mainSearchTol 6 (ppm), firstSearchTol 20. The paper/PRIDE "20ppm" is the first-search tolerance; the deposited main search wins.
parameters.txt "MS/MS tol. (ITMS) 0.5 Da"; MS2 is ion trap (raw); paper "MS/MS tolerance of 0.5Da".
"treated with 10 mM DTT for 30 min at 37 C".
"followed by 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature".

limitations: techsdrf is not installed; instrument, activation, NCE, MS2 analyzer, TopN and MS1 range come from HTTP-range-read .raw headers (inflated from the first ~3 MB of each single-member zip), not from spectra-level refinement.

The deposited raw files are zipped: each <stem>.raw ships inside a same-named <stem>.zip at https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2017/02/PXD005246/ ; comment[data file] names the .raw member (verified from each zip central directory). comment[file uri] is not licensed by ms-proteomics/human/cell-lines (absent from the contract and TERMS.tsv), so the archive mapping is recorded here and in the report (review round 1 F2).

The derived line 293-F10 (Flp-In T-REx 293 with tet-inducible c.o.-3xFLAG-F10) has no Cellosaurus record; the parental Flp-In-T-REx-293 (CVCL_U427) is annotated. No template column licenses genetic modification without clinical-metadata, so the transgene is recorded only in source name and the report.

characteristics[culture medium] = not available: SILAC labelling used "SILAC media (Sigma) supplemented with 10% FCS" whose base medium (DMEM vs RPMI) is not stated; routine maintenance was in DMEM but that is not the medium of the analysed cultures.

characteristics[ancestry category] = not available (Cellosaurus gives no population for CVCL_U427/HEK293); age = not available (Cellosaurus AG "Fetus" has no numeric age); cell type = not available (Cellosaurus states none); individual, passage number and sample storage temperature are not stated.

Version conflicts: paper/PRIDE say MaxQuant 1.2.2.5 and 20 ppm precursor tolerance; the deposited search (paper: "the uploaded version was generated by MaxQuant v. 1.3.0.5") has mainSearchTol 6 ppm / firstSearchTol 20 ppm. The deposited search was used.
Paper/PRIDE say the viral F10 sequence was added to the search database; the deposited proteinGroups.txt contains no non-human, non-contaminant entry. Not encoded; does not affect the SDRF values.
The samples are post-nuclear supernatant (cytoplasm + membranes) of the cells; no licensed column captures the subcellular fraction, so it is recorded here only.
